nuggets.text: The Tigers are making their first trip to Williams-Brice Stadium in program history, and it is the first-ever meeting with South Carolina.
Pete Shinnick won a Division II national title at West Florida in 2019, just the fourth year that program existed.
Pete Shinnick's father, Don Shinnick, played linebacker for the Baltimore Colts for 13 seasons.
Pete Shinnick once restarted UNC Pembroke football, a program that had been discontinued in the 1950s.
The Tigers have had only five head coaches since the program kicked off in 1969.
Johnny Unitas threw his last public pass at the Towson stadium now named for him, just days before his death in 2002.
Towson and Morgan State are the two closest teams in FCS football, just 4.6 miles apart, and they meet next week.
Towson was the first team in NCAA history to make the playoffs at the Division III, Division II and FCS levels.
Towson grad Brian Fleury is offensive coordinator of the Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks.
Cleveland Charlton, a 6-foot-5 receiver, is averaging 34 yards per catch for the Tigers this season.
